part2.title: Describe someone you know who is good at solving problems.
bullets: what kinds of problems they deal with
how they go about solving them
part2.closing: and explain why you think this person is so good at it.
follow_up: Has this person ever sorted out a problem for you?
Would other people describe them in the same way?

items.prompt: What qualities help a person deal with unexpected difficulties?
Are experienced workers better at handling difficulties than newer ones?
How might everyday problem-solving change as machines take on more tasks?
